about: The project's door: its read link (join/ answers, sealed per device) and its file-drop link (hello/). Empty = no automatic join; a group text works as before. More doors = tried in order (one may be gone). signer: "q_… z_…" of the signer device (↑ on its own tile copies it); set = only answers sealed by it count, empty = the description in join/.
